units.source_text: 很快，身披戎装，腰间配着檀香木弓、孔雀箭，

en.t: Before long, dressed in battle gear and wearing a sandalwood bow and peacock-feather arrows at his waist,

units.source_text: 像战神一样跨坐在黑狗上，手上抱着白狗和花斑狗，

en.t: he sat astride the black dog like a god of war, holding the white dog and the spotted dog in his arms,

units.source_text: 从天而降，落在飞鸟国大臣的府邸，两位武士的面前。

en.t: he descended from the sky and landed at the mansion of the minister of Asuka, right before the two warriors.
The two warriors were thrown into a panic.
